title: ToolkitRegistry
description: shepherd toolkit.json — project-local and user-global registry of commonly-used tools so a Claude Code session never forgets a capability exists.

version.description: Schema version. Always 1 for this release.

scope.description: Whether this file lives in the project workdir (local) or the user-global config dir (global).

updated_at.description: Unix epoch (seconds) of the last write to this file.

tools.description: Ordered list of registered tools. Local entries override global on name collision when scope=all is merged.

ToolEntry.title: ToolEntry
ToolEntry.description: A single registered tool. Required: name, scope, type, capabilities, description.

name.description: Unique key within a scope. Used as the lookup key for show/rm/pin/unpin.

scope.description: Storage routing: local → project workdir toolkit.json; global → user-global toolkit.json.

type.description: Tool category. Canonical: mcp | skill | plugin | cli. Non-canonical values (e.g. service, ssh) are permitted but will trigger a WARN during validate. Note: cli covers ssh/remote-shell targets (e.g. `ssh user@host`).

capabilities.description: Short capability slugs — what this tool can do (e.g. library-docs, api-reference, issue-tracking).

description.description: One-line human description. Shown in list/md output and injected into agent briefs.

invocation.description: How to invoke the tool (e.g. MCP tool name, slash command, CLI binary). Optional but strongly recommended for mcp/skill types.

when.description: Prose hint for the agent: when should this tool be reached for? Injected into md output.

pinned.description: Pinned tools appear first in list/md output regardless of insertion order.

added.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) when this entry was registered.

last_used.description: Unix epoch (seconds) of the most recent use. Updated by the operator or a hook; not managed by shctx automatically.
